title: Critical Apache Roller RCE Flaw Under Active Exploitation, No Authentication Required
content_md: A critical security flaw in Apache Roller, an open-source, Java-based blogging platform, has come under active exploitation in the wild, according to the Apache Software Foundation (ASF) The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-129448 (CVSS score: 9.8), is a case of unauthenticated deserialization in the XML-RPC endpoint that could lead to remote code execution.
